$comment: Deterministic per-step ceilings, measured on the committed synthetic fixture (npm run perf:fixture). Lowered as stories land: a change that lowers a number lowers it here in the same change; see README.md. The boot-bundle gzip budget is NOT here: it lives in bootBudgetPlugin (vite.config.ts). serialDepth is judged on the shallowest run and its ceiling is the deepest that has been on main, not one run; see GATES in budgets.ts. 3 Nov 2026 (#1138), re-set after the regressions since 9 Oct were fixed; what stayed was earned: dm-cold/dm-warm +1 API (touch_account_activity, hourly) and +5 chunks (the weather sky line, #1086, and modules that outgrew the 8 kB inline threshold); /npcs +2 API (kin_links for the family-links notice, which also warms the sheet's family block, #1083; open_books for the cards' in-the-book icon, #1085) and +3 chunks; dm-npc-detail +7 chunks (the Connections, Family and quick-fact sections, #1083/#1084); player-cold +3 API (character_caretakers, #1059; get_player_notice_boards for the presented board, #1064; touch_account_activity). 4 Nov 2026 (#1136): the soundboard deck docks under every DM page and shows its pads at once, so its pads, lanes, playlists and sounds are read at boot and on every resume; one batched request (lib/audio/deck/deckBatch.ts) instead of four, so dm-cold/dm-warm/resume +1 API, and dm-cold/dm-warm +2 chunks for the deck itself. dm-cold serialDepth 6 and /npcs serialDepth 2: CI measured dm-cold at 6 on main (run 41646820078) and here twice, with the deepest chain ending at embed-content/embed-monsters rather than the deck, and /npcs at 2 on main twice of three runs since #1138 (kin_links and open_books can land a wave after the list). 5 Nov 2026 (#1146): totalRequests is no longer gated, because fonts and images load or not depending on what is painted while the window is open (a Crimson Pro woff2 on dm-cold, the loading flag's bookmark-cloth.webp on dm-npc-detail); codeRequests (chunks and stylesheets) replaces it, at the counts every CI run from 3 to 5 Nov measured. serialDepth is now the minimum over runs, and pull requests run three like main: one deep run no longer fails a step. 5 Nov 2026 (Awareness Rolls): dm-cold/dm-warm +1 chunk. The rule's reading and its query joined the code the dashboard's Party widget and the Party page share, which took that common chunk (skillCheck, useActiveParty, useMemorials, cursedItems, useAwarenessRolls) to 11.6 kB, past the 8 kB inline threshold, so it is fetched once as a file instead of copied into both routes. 6 Nov 2026 (#1149): dm-cold/dm-warm +1 chunk. One initiative rule for every roll grew rules/encounterCombatLogic and rules/initiative, which the dashboard reads through the initiative widget and the party vitals, so their common chunk (encounterCombatLogic, with tokenFootprint and the turn rules) passed the 8 kB inline threshold and is fetched once as a file instead of copied into the dashboard, the encounter runner, the quest run tool and the play map.
